absent: Conversion from paravirtual clock info to reference page parameters.
Effects of master clock update requests on guest timing.
Synthetic interrupt controller, timer and debug register behaviors.
Host handling and userspace delivery for crash parameters.
Hypercall page patch selection across processor vendors.
Guest read path and fault handling for reference page access.
Segmentation helper determining page fragment lengths.
Assist page full layout and accelerated signaling protocol.
Reenlightenment, emulation and frequency register semantics.
Physical and logical interrupt map construction and inhibition impact.

findings.text: Virtual machine scoped publication of reference time data into guest memory from current paravirtual clock information, converging without caller retry across disabled, settled and faulted configurations.
Guest physical range stores spanning page boundaries through successive frame advance, succeeding only when every page fragment store succeeds.
Host originated marking of previously stable time data as stale when refresh is safe, otherwise leaving state untouched.
Single shot compatibility notice for a legacy guest image on multiprocessor guests with a particular extended state feature mix, skipped unless enlightenments are active.
Forwarding of virtual interrupt controller registers to the kernel local interrupt controller write path, declining when no kernel backing exists.

Partition wide register write dispatch for identity, hypercall page installation, time reference control, crash signaling, reset, reenlightenment and debug controls, with distinct host and guest origin handling.

Per processor register write dispatch for index assignment, assist page management, virtual interrupt controller pass through, runtime accounting, synthetic interrupt and timer programming, enforcing host only and read only limits.
Local interrupt controller register write dispatch with mode dependent writability and side effects including timer reprogramming, inter processor signaling, masking on disable and topology refresh.
Refresh safety combines page status with emulation control, treating guest originated change as always safe and otherwise following absence of emulation control.
Guest frame numbers scale by host page size to form guest physical addresses.
Guest register access succeeds unconditionally when enforcement is off, otherwise each functional group requires its own advertised enlightenment bit.
Hypercall page activation requires nonzero guest identity, clearing identity implicitly deactivates the page, and concurrent Xen intercept mode alters the installed guest entry encoding.
Enabling the time reference announces guest or host originated change according to initiator and requests master clock refresh, while disabling moves directly to unsettled.
Crash notification and reset intents are recorded as deferred processor requests with previously stored crash parameters retained for diagnostics.
Emulation status rejects nonzero guest updates while invariant timestamp control accepts only a narrow value set with monotonic guest enablement.
Compatibility screening runs at most once per virtual machine under exclusion, filtering by masked guest identity, multiprocessor topology and extended state capability mix before notifying.
Processor index reassignment is host only and bounded, tracking how many indices diverge from creation order.
Assist page enablement validates backing storage, clears only the assist word while preserving surrounding content and marking dirtiness, and disablement tears down accelerated signaling.
Visible processor runtime derives from host task processor time scaled to hundred nanosecond units, with host writes installing an offset relative to current consumption.
Timer instance selection follows register spacing, routing configuration and count writes to the indexed per processor timer while propagating origin.
Interrupt controller pass through accepts full width for the inter processor command register and rejects nonzero high half for all other registers.
Optimized interrupt routing rebuild is skipped when clean and guarded by kernel interrupt presence, warning on dirty state without kernel backing.
Per virtual machine exclusion serializes time reference state, identity observation and single shot compatibility marking across setup, request and warning paths.
Topology rebuild exclusion uses a dedicated mutex with dirty to in progress handshake and deferred reclamation, tolerating concurrent dirtiness and retrying on growth.
Reference page header starts with a sequence word whose width matches the host staging word, allowing torn update detection through zero versus nonzero observation.

Reference lifecycle covers unsettled, guest changed, host changed, settled and broken, where enablement announces change, setup converges toward settled or broken, host refresh reopens settled only when safe, and failures stick at broken.
Map maintenance moves among clean, dirty and update in progress, with growth driven retry and aliasing or identifier mismatch inhibiting accelerated delivery.
Publication first advertises zero sequencing to force fallback timing, orders content before announcement, then advertises nonzero sequencing while skipping reserved values.
Enablement or addressing changes trigger deferred global rebuild and scan work, so repeated toggling can amplify into allocation and rescheduling pressure.
Unrecognized register writes log conditionally, allowing silent guest divergence when ignored access reporting is disabled.
Legacy guest identity pattern equals hexadecimal 1040a00003839 for compatibility screening.
Identity comparison ignores the middle release octet spanning bits 23 through 16.
